name: erateradar
description: erateradar connects Claude and ChatGPT to public USAC E-rate data for IT, network and cabling providers. Ask for open Category 2 Form 470s (school and library Wi-Fi, switches, cabling, firewalls, UPS) within up to 60 miles of a ZIP or city, or in a state; open one Form 470 with every requested line item as USAC lists it; or see what a buyer reported on its previous request: bids received, the provider it chose, the pre-discount cost and the USAC status. Every row links to its USAC Open Data record and to the same list in the erateradar web app. All tools are read-only and answer in pages of at most 25 rows. USAC records are self-reported and do not promise a purchase or a winning bid.

defaultPrompt: Find open E-rate network bids within 60 miles of ZIP 60601, nearest first.
Which public libraries have open E-rate network bids, and who did each one pick last time?

positive.description: Checks that “Find open E-rate switch and Wi-Fi bids within 60 miles of ZIP 60601.” returns A count of open Category 2 Form 470s within 60 miles of ZIP 60601 that request switches or wireless access points (USAC data date shown), then up to 10 rows: buyer, city, the engine's one-line summary, miles, earliest contract date and the USAC record link; total and nextOffset when there are more; a link to the same list in the web app..

publication.release_notes: 1.0: three read-only tools over USAC E-rate data (find open Category 2 Form 470s near a place or in a state, one Form 470 with its USAC line items, a buyer's previous request), OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE, sign-up inside the consent page.
